name: Parse Server
line: Self-hosted backend framework with auth, files, Cloud Code, and jobs.

free.text: Apache-2.0; no hosted quota or idle rule; you run the server and database

cells.metered: Software $0; infrastructure is yours to run

sql.math: $0 software fee. App server, database, storage, traffic and backups depend on the provider you pick.
The software stays $0. Kept server, database, file and backup costs depend on the host.

files.math: Parse has a file API. File capacity, requests, delivery and provider rates are separate and not priced.

jobs.math: Jobs have no software fee. Server capacity and worker size are not priced until a host is chosen.
